== English errata comparison sources ==
The PC slip gives the text as of 1 January 2013. The replacement checks the number of cards with ability deployed by the end of the opponent’s deploy phase. The earlier Decipher Supplement entry points to the definition of a card with ability and supplies no replacement wording. The prior Wiki date was based on a later edition.

Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 7. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=6|Decipher Errata]], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 6. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=102|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 102. [[:File:CC-D-abilityabilityability.gif|Complete replacement face]]. Earlier ruling: Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary Supplement.pdf#page=1|Glossary Supplement]], updated 29 January 2002, PDF page 1. The printed article retains its existing documentary identifier 5_110o. Its explicit GEMP display field is blank because the pinned Guild directory and mapping lack that class and alias.
